decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos'): pass iff (1) one-sided t of the net-1x per-event P&L (day-clustered; stationary/day-cluster bootstrap >= 430,000 draws) >= 3.6807; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md (years, concentration, terciles, +-25% neighbours on entry/exit times or thresholds, one-bar delay) pass; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Anything else is 'refuted' or 'near-miss' (near-miss = t >= 2.0 with criterion 3 passed); the result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length. Derivative rule (D-009): the evidence displays 2008-2026, so the decision window is 1990-01-02..2007-12-31 only; 2008-2016 rows in the file are never read for this row.
hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Sharp two-day falls in gold futures are partly forced selling (margin calls, CTA de-risking) and revert within 1-3 sessions. Sign fixed: long after the fall.
rules: Daily excess-return series r_t of the listed roots in daily_futures_1984_2016 (US close-to-close, roll inside the series). Price index P_t = cumulative product of (1 + r_t). Signal at close of day t: R2_t = r_{t-1} + r_t (two-day return); sigma2_t = sqrt(2) x s.d.(r) over days t-59..t (60 observations, at least 50 non-missing). If R2_t < -2 x sigma2_t and no position is open in that root, BUY at the close of day t+1 (one-day delay: daily data has no open, and a fill at the signal close would be look-ahead). EXIT at the close of the first day u >= t+2 on which P_u > mean(P_{u-4..u}) (5-day mean of the index), or at the close of day t+4 at the latest (3 sessions after entry). No pyramiding, one position per root, no stops (the FTMO 5%/10% guard is applied by the portfolio layer, guard_fraction). Days with |r| > 25% (the inherited loader's listed bad days) are set to missing before the signal.
parameters: root GC (gold); trigger 2-day return < -2 sigma (60-day); entry next close; exit first close above 5-day mean or after 3 sessions
instruments: FTMO XAUUSD CFD (tested on GC futures excess returns)
vol_scaler: weight = 0.10/sqrt(252) / EWMA (com 60 days) s.d. of r through the signal day; no cap.
cost_model: 1x floors per briefs/00-common.md: 1 bp per side gold CFD + financing markup 3%/yr per calendar day held on top of the roll embedded in the excess return (FTMO gold long swap about -5.2%/yr per candidates.md; 2x run at 2 bp per side and 6%/yr markup). 2x run attached.
notes: Source: candidates.md rank 27 (SC C-8-06), gold as the secondary market, counted separately because gold's mechanism (no roll carry for a long; swap negative) and correlation with the energy leg differ. EVIDENCE WINDOW: blog CL/GC 2008-2026 (in-sample) -> decided on 1990-2007 only. Closed family: G2 (index CFDs) adjacent, new market. OOS 18 years: bar 0.87; power 1.00 at true Sharpe 1.5. Realistic: about 10 trades/yr, 15-25 bp after haircut vs about 250 bp s.d. per 3 sessions -> annual Sharpe about 0.2 -> power under 0.1. Economics: 15-25 bp vs 2 bp round trip + about 2.5 bp markup = 3-5x. Red Team strongest objection: 1990-2001 was a gold bear market with central-bank selling; a long-only dip buy is tested against a drift it did not choose - answered by reporting the excess over the unconditional long-gold mean as a diagnostic (the gate stays on the raw net P&L). Hold-out data not in hand (GC 2025-2026 daily: Databento about $0.05 or LBMA free). Family commodity-dip-swing holds 2 of 5 counts after this row.
